name: CorpTimer
googleShortDescription: Timers for meetings, boxing, workouts, focus and everyday routines.
description:
Make time for it with CorpTimer.

Build a meeting agenda, set up your next training session or start a quick countdown. Save your programs and come back to them whenever you need a little structure.

MEETINGS
Give every speaker a place in the agenda. Early finishes pass spare time forward; overruns reduce the time left for later turns. Drag participants into order, see the next speaker budget and segmented progress, resize the plan, save templates and review original-plan versus actual reports. Pause, hand off, extend a turn and keep private notes.

WORKOUTS
Configure boxing rounds, rest, preparation and cool-down. Start from HIIT, Tabata, EMOM and AMRAP presets or customize individual rounds and sets.

FOCUS AND EVERYDAY TIMERS
Use Pomodoro focus sessions, classroom visual timers, two-player chess clocks, a stopwatch with laps, countdowns and a New Year timer with a selected time zone.

MAKE IT YOURS
Save named programs on your device. Import and export JSON setups, and export session results as CSV. Choose bundled sounds, optional in-app spoken cues and haptic feedback.

No paid account, ads or subscription. Programs, notes and history stay on your device. Optional live sharing publishes the meeting title, public agenda and countdown through Firebase with anonymous authentication; private notes and reports are excluded. Keep the app open while hosting. Background alerts require notification permission and follow your phone's settings; spoken cues play while the app is open.

ADJUST BY TOUCH
Turn a rotary dial to set durations, with optional click sounds and haptics, or keep using direct numeric entry. Support & feedback opens an in-app form. Only the message you choose to send, an optional reply email, category, app version and platform go through Web3Forms to support; meeting data is not attached.
releaseNotes: A one-hour Meeting starter: five-minute Welcome and five equal participants. Rotary time controls with optional mechanical clicks and numeric entry. Unclipped normal clock. In-app support form through a delivery service, without a published recipient address.
reviewNotes: No end-user account is required. Meeting starts with Welcome (5 minutes) and five synthetic participants (11 minutes each). Rotate a duration dial or type a number. Start, pause, hand off early and drag dedicated agenda handles. Support is in-app and routes through Web3Forms; no recipient address is in the client. Live sharing is explicit and uses anonymous Firebase authentication. Android floating mode needs special display-over-other-apps permission. Android emulator verification is documented in VALIDATION.md; physical devices and iOS remain separate gates. A publisher-owned public support page and privacy notice are required before store submission.
